lines.en: Most business plans written with AI fall apart at the first hard question.
lines.zh: 大多数用 AI 写的商业计划书，经不起第一个尖锐问题。

lines.en: Bankable is a Claude skill, built to survive them.
lines.zh: Bankable 是一个 Claude skill，专为经得起拷问而生。

lines.en: It works by three rules.
lines.zh: 它遵循三条规则。

lines.en: Numbers come before the story.
lines.zh: 数字先于故事。

lines.en: Every claim has a source.
lines.zh: 每个主张都有出处。

lines.en: And nothing about your company is ever invented.
lines.zh: 关于你公司的一切，绝不编造。

lines.en: Setup takes a minute.
lines.zh: 安装只需一分钟。

lines.en: Upload the skill file to Claude, or clone the repository into your Claude Code skills folder.
lines.zh: 把 skill 文件上传到 Claude，或把仓库克隆到 Claude Code 的 skills 目录。

lines.en: Then describe what you need, attach whatever you have, and say who will read it.
lines.zh: 然后描述需求、附上已有材料，并说明谁来读。

lines.en: Bankable asks at most eight questions, logs every assumption, and builds the financial model first.
lines.zh: Bankable 最多问八个问题，登记每一条假设，先搭财务模型。

lines.en: Only then does it write, and test the draft the way an investor, a banker, a reviewer, and a CFO would.
lines.zh: 然后才动笔，并像投资人、银行、评审专家和 CFO 那样拷问初稿。

lines.en: Investors, banks, government reviewers, or your board.
lines.zh: 投资人、银行、政府评审，或是你的董事会——

lines.en: The chapters and the metrics adapt to the reader.
lines.zh: 章节与指标随读者而变。

lines.en: You get a Word business plan, in English, Chinese, or both.
lines.zh: 一份 Word 商业计划书：英文、中文或双语。

lines.en: A live, three statement Excel model, with scenarios and sensitivity.
lines.zh: 一个可重算的三表 Excel 模型，含情景与敏感性分析。

lines.en: An evidence register.
lines.zh: 一份证据登记册。

lines.en: And a pitch deck, all tied to the same numbers.
lines.zh: 以及一套路演 PPT——全部对齐同一套数字。

lines.en: Correct an assumption, rerun, and every figure in the plan updates with it.
lines.zh: 改一条假设、重跑，计划书里的每个数字随之更新。

lines.en: Bankable.
lines.zh: Bankable。

lines.en: Business plans that survive due diligence.
lines.zh: 经得起拷问的商业计划书。
